notes: Deterministic member ordering and identity: build a packing tool whose index and ZIP bundle derive member order from plain UTF-8 byte sorting (never locale collation) and carry zero host-identity fields (no owner/group/uid, no mtimes, fixed 1980 ZipInfo timestamps, external_attr 0, STORED, fresh ZipInfo per member). Medium floor from the multi-surface determinism contract (byte-identity across runs and across mtime-shifted/re-ordered tree copies, structural ZIP metadata checks) plus subtle sort cases (case, unicode, prefix ties). Hidden cases probe byte-order-only distinguishable name sets, a deep/binary/duplicate-content tree, and a synthesized empty tree; the verifier executes /app/pack_index.py unchanged on all of them.
